title: Register a change of name
summary: You can register a change of name online, but you must check eligibility and requirements first.
intro:
If you want to change your name, you can do it online. You can change your name only once in a 12-month period and 3 times in your lifetime.

Changing your name or the name of a child is a complex process. For information on eligibility, required documents and how to apply, visit Change of name – NSW Registry of Births, Deaths & Marriages.
who_can_apply: Were born or adopted in NSW.
Were born overseas and have lived in NSW for the past 3 years.
Have not changed your name with any Australian Registry in the past 12 months.
Have not previously registered 3 official changes of name in Australia.
Parents, guardians, and caseworkers can register a change of name for children under 18 years.

how_to_steps.text: Check the eligibility and document requirements at Change of name – NSW Registry of Births, Deaths & Marriages.
Gather the documents you need, including proof of identity.
Complete the online form and payment.

faqs.q: How many times can I change my name?
faqs.a: You can change your name up to 3 times in your lifetime, and you can only change it once within a 12-month period.

faqs.q: Can parents change a child's name?
faqs.a: Yes, parents, guardians, and caseworkers can register a change of name for children under 18 years.

faqs.q: Where can I find information on eligibility and required documents?
faqs.a: You must check the eligibility and document requirements at Change of name – NSW Registry of Births, Deaths & Marriages.
